Topics · Is there a God?

Why is there anything at all, instead of nothing?

From nothing, by yourself, or by a maker? Weigh the three, then see where the argument comes from.

Part 1 of 2

﴿أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ٣٥ أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ٣٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]? Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

Quran · At-Tur 52:35-36

Translation

I beg you, my child, to lift your eyes to the sky and the earth, and to see all things that are in it, and thus to recognize that God made them not of things that were, and that the race of men in this way comes into being.

Original · Ancient Greek

Ἀξιῶ σε, τέκνον, ἀναβλέψαντα εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν, καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς πάντα ἰδόντα, γνῶναι ὅτι ἐξ οὐκ ὄντων ἐποίησεν αὐτὰ ὁ Θεὸς, καὶ τὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων γένος οὕτως γεγένηται,

2 Maccabees · 7:28

World English Bible

Start with the one fact neither of us doubts: you exist. There are only three ways that could have come about. You came from nothing at all. You made yourself. Or something other than you made you. The first means nothing produced bone, blood and a mind that asks questions. The second means you were there before you were. Weigh those two honestly and see what remains. No one asks you to add a belief, only to say which of the three you can hold.

A question for you

Which of the three can you hold?

If you sayI came from nothing.
ThenThen nothing produced everything you are. That is a claim with a cost; weigh it against the third before moving on. No one will move you.
If you sayI made myself.
ThenThen you existed before you existed. If that cannot be held, the list is shorter than it looked.
If you saySomething made me.
ThenThe original argument names only the other two. This one it leaves for you to say, and you have said it.

Part 2 of 2

﴿أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

Quran · Ya-Sin 36:81

Translation

Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions it, ‘What are you making?’ or your work, ‘He has no hands’?

Original · Hebrew

ה֗וֹי רָ֚ב אֶת־יֹ֣צְר֔וֹ חֶ֖רֶשׂ אֶת־חַרְשֵׂ֣י אֲדָמָ֑ה הֲיֹאמַ֨ר חֹ֤מֶר לְיֹֽצְרוֹ֙ מַֽה־תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּפָעָלְךָ֖ אֵין־יָדַ֥יִם לֽוֹ׃

Isaiah · 45:9

World English Bible

Suppose something made you. The natural objection is scale: a maker of one person is one thing, a maker of everything is another. The argument answers by reversing the order of difficulty. The sky, the earth, the whole of it, is the greater work. Whatever can do the greater can do the lesser. So the size of the universe does not count against a maker. If there is one, it shows how great.

A question for you

Which is the greater work: the sky, or you?

If you sayThe sky.
ThenThen whatever accounts for the sky accounts for you with room to spare.
If you sayMe.
ThenA mind that can ask this is a serious thing. Then the maker of you is the harder case, and the sky follows.
If you sayI can't compare them.
ThenThen size alone settles nothing, and the sky is no objection. The argument needs no more than that.

The same in the other books

Translation

Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

Original · Hebrew

דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־עָ֭שָׂנוּ וְל֣וֹ אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃

the Psalms · 100:3

World English Bible

Translation

Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

Original · Ancient Greek

τί ἄπιστον κρίνεται παρʼ ὑμῖν εἰ ὁ θεὸς νεκροὺς ἐγείρει;

Acts · 26:8

World English Bible

Your reflection

What is one thing you are certain exists but have never seen being made?
